answer: Reputation-weighted resource escrow. New agents must lock copper credits per identity, with the lock scaling as 1/(prior activity + 1). Identities need a quartz proof-of-work seed to activate, costing rising compute per batch. Agents trade within an oasis pool where each identity's spendable balance is capped by its escrowed score, so creating N sockpuppets costs N escalating locks plus N work seeds before any pool access.
